description: Step 2 of the buyer path. Full profile for ONE provider — plans, pricing model, liveness, evidence — use after search_providers returns handles. Evidence-scored profile: task_performed, inputs/outputs, integrations, protocols, industry_fit, autonomy_level, human_approval_needed, observed price, trust signals, evidence_quality, entity_type, regulated_data_suitability, evidence_urls, last_checked. Includes the full how_to_connect object — website, docs, any vendor-published MCP endpoint (with a copy-paste client config_snippet), A2A agent card and API surface — the info needed to actually use the listing; fields are null when the vendor publishes no endpoint (never guessed). Also carries `reported_success` — machine-reported outcome rate from report_outcome (null until 5+ distinct correlated reporters in 90 days). If you use the listing, call report_outcome afterwards. Also (1.10.0) `deployment` — hosted / self_hosted / both / unknown with the evidence (excerpt, source URL, observation day, age) — `licence` (named licence only; a public repository is not a licence), `how_to_connect.install` and `how_to_connect.repository`, and `price_applies_to` when the price page is the vendor platform, not this connector.

history_days.description: Window for price_history in days (1–400, default 90).

plan.description: Optional plan name filter for price_history.

price_history.description: Optional (1.17.0): include this provider's dated plan prices from Agentery's stored observations — periods at one published price, changes, coverage gaps, promotion/anomaly flags. Dates are observation dates, not necessarily when the vendor changed the price; prices stay in their original currency.

provider_id.description: The provider_id/handle returned by search_providers or compare_providers

name: get_provider_profile
